title: Speed before and after
statement:
Give the average response time before a fix and after it.

The input has two arrays of times, `before` and `after`. Give an object with the same two keys. Each value is the average of that array: the sum of the numbers divided by how many there are. The arrays are never empty.
reference:
def avg: add / length;
{before: (.before | avg), after: (.after | avg)}
